Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.odps

Class DataProductOutputPort

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.odps.DataProductOutputPort
public class DataProductOutputPort extends Object
This class represents an output port of an Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) data product. An output port identifies data that the data product provides to its consumers, described by an Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract. There is a separate output port entry for each version.
